name: How long does kitchen finish carpentry take to complete?

mainEntity.name: How long does kitchen finish carpentry take to complete?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration for kitchen finish carpentry depends on the project's size and complexity. For a small kitchen with basic trim and molding, it might take a few days. A larger kitchen with extensive custom work, intricate crown molding, wainscoting, or built-in features could take one to two weeks or even longer. Factors like material availability, drying times for any finishes applied on-site, and coordination with other trades also affect the timeline. Your contractor can provide a more accurate estimate after assessing your specific needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Completion time for kitchen finish carpentry ranges from a few days for basic trim to several weeks for extensive custom work, depending on project scope.
